THE ONE CARRIER of the coverage block's shape (`coverage_block_shape`): the orders QUOTE it and check_lt_r3.py BUILDS ITS POSITIVE RECORDS FROM IT, and `selftest-arms` refuses if any round-3 order's quoted block differs from this file. That is LGIC_ENFORCE-S85's rule adopted as construction: a positive-satisfiability arm fed the checker's own vocabulary proves nothing about the record the ORDER tells a worker to write. Every figure carries a `claim` field; a cell RE-MEASURES a moving figure at its own write time.

floor.WHAT_THE_FLOOR_IS: A FLOOR, NOT THE DEFINITION OF 'INVOLVED'. It is the token leg only. The cell's own 'involved' instrument may reach MORE (a trigger target, an IAM grant, a source-text reference that carries no token) and must reach AT LEAST this, or name each floor node it excludes with a per-node reason. R-79 (b): the definition is the DESIGN's, and this file does not pre-empt it.
floor.RE_MEASURED_AT_GRADE_TIME: Every arm that reads the floor RE-RUNS the instrument and prints both the cut figure and its own. The graph rebuilds daily; a floor read from this file at grade time would be a stale figure acting as a bar.

coverage.vintage: <the graph's own 'Built from the estate as of ...' line>

rules: `coverage` is a TOP-LEVEL key of contract.json, beside `rows`.
`legs` is a non-empty subset of the four named legs; which ones is the cell's design.
Per node_type: involved == rows + len(not_covered). `rows` equals the count of contract rows of that node_type whose node is involved.
`excluded` holds FLOOR nodes the definition judges NOT involved, each with a non-empty reason. For a NAMED CLASS both `excluded` and `not_covered` must be empty.
Every node_type present in the floor appears in by_node_type.

render_markers.bare_none_refused: No rendered line may be exactly '(none)' after stripping whitespace, in any column of flow.current.md or flow.desired.md.
render_markers.no_coverage_block: A contract WITHOUT a coverage block renders, in EVERY column section of flow.current.md, a line containing 'NOT MEASURED' -- an old contract's columns are statements about an instrument that never measured coverage, including the non-empty ones.
render_markers.with_coverage_block: A contract WITH a coverage block renders, in every column section, a line containing '<R> row(s) of <I> involved', where R and I are the sums over the node_types the renderer assigns to that column.
